description:
One-shot operator-only repair for `session_ledger__summary` rows whose `embedding_vector_id` was written with the pgvector internal id (`emb-...`) instead of the deterministic external_id (`{session_id}:{chunk_index}`). Rewrites each stale pointer in place so the ANN search join in `search_sessions` / `list_summaries_by_external_ids` reaches the row.

Why stale pointers existed. Earlier, `SummaryWriter._store_vector` returned the pgvector internal id (`inserted_ids[0]`) instead of the deterministic external_id. `persist_summary` wrote that internal id directly into `__summary.embedding_vector_id`. The ANN search path keys its score map by `embedding.external_id` and `list_summaries_by_external_ids` looks up summary rows via `WHERE embedding_vector_id IN (external_ids)` — the IN clause never matched and `search_sessions` silently returned `[]`. The forward fix landed in `summarization.py:_store_vector` (return external_id, not inserted_ids[0]); this verb cleans up the historical damage.

Flow. Single `UPDATE FROM` joining `<schema>.session_ledger__summary` to `<schema>.session_ledger_summary__embeddings` on `summary.embedding_vector_id = embedding.id`, rewriting `summary.embedding_vector_id := embedding.external_id`, gated by `LIKE 'emb-%'` for idempotency and `is_deleted = 0` for active-row scope. Per-row count math wraps the UPDATE in a single transactional block: `updated_count = before_broken - after_broken`, `skipped_count = after_broken` (rows whose paired embedding row lacks an external_id), `total_rows_now_correct = active_summary_count - after_broken`.

No cron pause needed. Post-fix M6 writes carry external_id-shaped pointers (`les_xxx:N`) that don't satisfy the `LIKE 'emb-%'` filter, so any concurrent M6 cron firing during the repair is invisible to the UPDATE.

Default `confirm=false` returns a structured dry-run carrying the broken-pointer count so the operator can size the repair before committing. Pass `confirm=true` to actually run.

This verb is `is_discoverable=false` — the model cannot find it via `process_search` and never proposes it. Operator-only via the operator bridge.
embedding_description: Operator-only one-shot repair: rewrite __summary.embedding_vector_id from pgvector internal id (emb-...) to deterministic external_id for rows written by earlierbuggy _store_vector. UPDATE FROM joining __summary to summary__embeddings on internal id, gated by LIKE 'emb-%' for idempotency. Default dry-run; confirm=true. Without this, search_sessions/events return [] for ANN-stale rows.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Backfill repair outcome. `confirmed=false` is a dry-run; `confirmed=true` ran the rewrite. `updated_count` is the number of rows whose `embedding_vector_id` was rewritten; `skipped_count` is the count of broken-pointer rows whose paired embedding row lacked an `external_id` (left in place); `total_rows_now_correct` is the count of active `__summary` rows now addressable by the ANN search join.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: After a confirmed repair, run `search_sessions` against a KB-attested phrase (e.g. 'session ledger') and confirm >0 hits. If `skipped_count > 0`, inspect those rows via `SELECT id, session_id, embedding_vector_id FROM <schema>.session_ledger__summary WHERE embedding_vector_id LIKE 'emb-%' AND is_deleted = 0` (via `state_service::execute_sql`) — their paired embedding row in `<schema>.session_ledger_summary__embeddings` lacks an `external_id`, which itself is a deeper bug worth surfacing to the operator.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Single UPDATE rewriting `__summary.embedding_vector_id` from pgvector internal id to the canonical external_id for earlierstale-pointer rows.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: LedgerRepositoryError: the underlying state_service rejected the UPDATE FROM, the dry-run COUNT, or the after-state COUNT. Possible causes: schema not yet initialized (no `<schema>.session_ledger_summary__embeddings` table), state_service unavailable, or a transient connection failure mid-transaction.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm `list_sources` returns the active source roster (proves state_service is responsive). Confirm the pgvector embeddings table exists via `SELECT count(*) FROM <schema>.session_ledger_summary__embeddings` (via `state_service::execute_sql`). Re-run the verb — the `LIKE 'emb-%'` idempotency guard makes repeat runs safe. If the failure persists, the UPDATE may be hitting a row-lock contention from an in-flight `push_summary_chunk` write; the verb may be retried after the M6 cron's next quiescent window.
